test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
A table showing the percentages of the total population of a town by age groups for the year 2016 is given below. 

 
 

 **Age Group (in years)**
 **Per cent**
 
 

 up to 15
 35
 
 

 16-30
 18.5
 
 

 30-40
 12.5
 
 

 40-50
 25.77
 
 

 51 and above
 8.23
 
 

There are 2200 billion people below 40 years. How many billion people are in the age group 40-50
solution:
**Given:**

Percentage of people in age group up to 15 years = 35%

Percentage of people in age group 16-30 years = 18.5%

Percentage of people in age group 30-40 years = 12.5%

Percentage of people in age group 40-50 years = 25.77%

Percentage of people in age group 51 and above = 8.23%

Total number of people below 40 years = 2200 billion

**Formula Used:**

Total percentage below 40 years = Percentage i
